sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Genjutsu (Visual, Tactile), Water Release, Medical

system.description:
A genjutsu that causes the target to experience a drowning sensation, exhausting themselves as if their body truly underwent physical trauma. Select one target within range. This creature must make a Wisdom saving throw.

Blood Detonation. You can select up to two creatures as part of this jutsu’s casting.

Success: The creature is able to resist this jutsu's effects.

Failure: The creature loses sight of their surroundings, falls into a blood red ocean for several days, constantly trying to escape and not drown. The creature is Restrained, takes 3d8 psychic damage and gains 1 rank of Exhaustion. Affected creatures remake their saving throw at the end of each of their turns, breaking free of the restrained condition and ending this jutsu’s effects on them. They keep any exhaustion gained at the end of their following turn.

Critical Failure: Same effects as a failure, but the target takes 5d8 psychic damage and they gain 2 ranks of Exhaustion.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, the damage by 1d8 and the ranks of Exhaustion by +1
